tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i snying po'i mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi ba'i bdag nyid 'jigs byed 'jigs su rung ba'i sku// brjod med bdag nyid sna tshogs sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i gsung*// rtog med bdag nyid thugs rjes dkyil 'khor khyab pa'i thugs// srid zhi'i bdag nyid he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig la gnas pa 'i rnal 'byor pas yid mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi ri lu'am/ dam tshig gi rdzas sbyar bas/ phyogs dang bdag nyid la gtor zhing*/ bhur bhu wa swaḥ oṃ aḥ s+thā me rak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ aḥ ad ma nāṃ me rak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ yo ghaṃ me rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o// de nas bdag nyid skad cig gis zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i bcom ldan 'das su bsgoms pas lus dag par byas la a li dang ka li hūm̐ phaṭa dang bcas pa brjod pas ngag sbyang zhing*/ shri he ru ka ham̐ zhes yid dag par bya'o// de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha ka yi kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na bā tsi kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gh+ri h+na pa ya gh+ri h+na pa ya tsī da ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra dzña ni kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes phyogs dang mtshams su sngags kyi gur khang*/ 'og tu raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyi rol du rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi/ rdo rje lnga'i gur khang*/ steng rdo rje'i bla re/ phyi rol du mda'i drwa ba/ de'i phyi rol du phyogs su g.yon bskor du khwa dang 'ug pa dang*/ khyi dang phag pa'i gdong pa can dang*/ me nas mtshams rnams su g.yas bskor gyis gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ pho nya mo mche ba can 'joms ma rnams g.yon phur pa g.yas rdo rje'i tho ba bsnams pa'i mdun du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i dong bsams te/

sarba bigh+na a na ya dzaḥ zhes phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug ste/ dong du bcug nas/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya sarba dus ṣ+ṭan phaṭa ki la ya sarba pā pan phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra ki la ya badz+ra dha ro a dzña pa ya ti sarba bhi gh+na ka ya bag tsi ta badz+ra ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes phur bus gdab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra mud gā ra badz+ra ki la a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bde ba chen po myong bar byas nas rdo rje dang pad ma dang 'khor lo'i ra ba dang me dpung gis mtshams bcing bar bya'o// de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bltas nas/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ pra ba ra sad ka ra pā t+yam̐ pra ti ts+tsha ya swāhā zhes zhal bsil dang*/ zhabs bsil phul la/ oṃ ā badz+ra pu pe hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhi pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghan dhe hūm̐: oṃ aḥbadz+ra ne pe te hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// 'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po// yid bzhin nor bu 'dir byung ba// dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// thugs rjes 'gro ba drag chen po// dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya bas bstod pa bya'o// bgyid dang bgyid brtsal rjes su yid rang la sogs sdig pa ma lus pa ni skyon rnams ma lus nges par bcom pa'i// mdun du so sor bshags bya slar la yang ni mi byed pa'i sdom pa bzung ba nyid du bya// nyan thos dang ni bse ru bla med rgyal ba rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsags pa'i dge ba la// rjes su yid ni rang zhing byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bdag gis bya// rgyal ba rin chen la sogs gsum la ji snyed skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba thams cad du ni bsgom// byang chub sems ni rnam par bzung ngo bla na med pa'i lam ni de bzhin bsten// de nas/

oṃ aḥbadz+ra mu hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas gshegs par bya'o// de nas snying rje byams pa dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dran par bya'o// de'i rjes su/ oṃ sarba dha rma/ shu n+yā ta swa bhā bā shu n+yo haṃ/ oṃ sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud dha/ swa bha bā shud dho haṃ/ oṃ n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swa bha bā ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud dhaḥsarba dharmaḥ yo ga shud dho haṃ/ zhes bya ba brjod cing*/ don dran par byas te chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgom par bya'o// dang po'i sbyor ba'o// de nas smon lam rjes su dran pas na de las 'og gi phyogs su 'od 'phros te/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu lta bu/ ram̐ las me dmar po zur gsum pa/ bam̐ las chu dkar po zlum po/ lam̐ las sa ser po gru bzhi/ sum̐ las ri rab/ phyogs kyi kha dog can/ yam̐ las sna tshogs pad ma/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o// de thams cad zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas la gnas pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba kun nas bzlum po sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa nag pa dang ljang ba'i brtsig pa gnyis dang ldan pa pha gu dang drwa ba phyed pa dang gzeng khang dang mda' yab thog byur bu rdo rje dang gdugs rim pa bcu gsum nor bu tog dang ldan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo dang ye shes kyi dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'i dbus 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i steng du/ a li zla ba me long lta bu/ ka li nyi ma mnyam pa nyid/ de'i dbus su na da las hūm̐ yig so sor rtog pa thams cad cig tu gyur pa bya ba nan tan/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las chos dbyings rnam par dag pa 'i rgyu'i he ru ka sku mdog dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yon dang rgyab dang g.yas kyi zhal bzhi rim pa bzhin du dkar ljang dmar ser ba spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can/

g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ rdo rje dril bus shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ gnyis kyis glang po'i lpags pa can/ g.yas 'og ma rnams ḍa ma ru/ dgra sta/ gri gug rtse gsum pa/ g.yon 'og ma kha ṭ+wām̐ ga/ thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo can/ shes rab rdo rje phag mo gri gug thod pa can zhabs g.yas pa dang phyag g.yon pas 'khyud pa'o// snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yab kyi gsang bar gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje byam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' las pad ma d+yam̐ gyis mtshan par byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang bde ba chen po'i snod kyi rang bzhin nyi shu rtsa bzhi spros te/ shar nas mkha' 'gro ma/ gzugs can ma/ 'od byed ma/ gzhan bsgyur ma/ byis bcas ma/ rjes 'jug ma/ phyed nag phyed sngo can no// byang phyogs nas lā ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ bzang mo/ thod pa can nag mo /rgyal bskor ma ste phyed ljang phyed dmar ro// nub phyogs nas dum skyes ma/ dur khrod ma/ rnam par zhu ma/ ku ru ku la/ glu ma gar ma/ phyed dmar phyed ser can no// lho phyogs nas gzugs can ma/ 'jigs byed ma/ gtsug pud ma/ thor tshugs can/ ral pa can/ drag mo rnams phyed ser phyed nag thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan phag mo lta bu'o// mtshams su bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa dang thod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i snyoms 'jug las spros te rgyu'i he ru ka'o// de nas 'bras bu'i he ru ka ni gtso bo yab yum bde ba chen po'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba las mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa drug gis mgrin gcig tu tshad med pa'i glus bskul ba ni/ mnga' bdag nyi ma re rer 'gro bas mgron 'bod na// khyod ni ci'i phyir na stong pa nyid du bzhugs/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te// rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod// lā ma la sogs pa rnams kyis/

gson cig gson cig gzhan gyi dogs pa nub// 'jig rten dbang phyug gang dag shi ba bzhin du 'gyur// bdag gis pad ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod// de ltar 'jig rten kun bder gyur par byos// dum skyes ma la sogs pas/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la rol cig rol// lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob// sems can 'jig rten gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas// ji ltar khyod ni stong ba don med gyur// gzugs can ma la sogs pas kyang*// khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed pa ste// ci phyir lhan skyes 'gro med bzhugs// bdag la mchog gi don gyis 'dod pa mdzod// ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnams mthun bzhugs// de nas de rnams thig le nyid la zhugs par blta'o// de nas thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ hūm̐ ljang sngon sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ aḥkā bag tsit+ta badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ho: zhes bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa nyi zla dang*/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang*/ 'dod lha dga' bo g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas gnan pa'i khro bo chen po nam mkha' dang ye shes dag pa'i sku nag po dang ljang khu phyed phyed pa zhal bcu bdun/ phyag bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ zhal rtsa ba nag po dang ljang khu/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab dmar lhag pa'i zhal bung ba'i mdog can/ spyan gsum gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs par byed pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ rus pa dang rin po che dang thal ba'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod pa brgya'i phreng ba dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar gyi cod pan dang 'od zer gyi phreng bas mdzes pa g.yas kyi phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bus 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis glang po che'i lpags pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis spyi bor skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas bzhi pa la sogs pa rnams kyis/

ral gri/ mdung ring*/ rtse gsum/ dgra sta/ gri gug mda'/ gsal shing gis phug pa/ tho ba/ 'khor lo/ cang te'u/ chu gri/ dbyug to/ mtshon rtse cig dung*/ zangs dung*/ dbyig gu/ rma bya'i mjug ma/ bya rog sgro/ pir/ me thab/ ri bo/ dbyug pa/ me long*/ pi wang*/ rkang mgo lag mgo glo ba/ rgyu ma/ sgra gcan/ lcags sgrog gdos/ nya rgya/ gdub bu/ mgo med/ 'bar ba'i mar nag 'jigs byed gzugs rim pa bzhin no/ g.yon du phub ring*/ mche ba/ gtun shing*/ zhags pa/ thod pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wam̐ ga /po ti/ phub chung yu can/ sdig 'dzub/ g.yer ka /phreng ba/ lcags sgrog brag /dur khrod kyi rdul/ 'bo khang*/ rnga/ lpags pa rlon pa/ skra'i thag pa/ ro bsreg shing bu/ 'phongs/ phub/ mgo bo/ keng rus/ zor ba/ mig /mkhal ma/ snye ma/ spen pa'i phur bu/ sa bon gang ba/ sog le/ khab/ slud bu/ sprin/ shing*/ lcags kyu rnams g.yon pa'o// rdo rje phag mo ni kha dog dmar po/ zhal cig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa can/ bdud rnams sdigs par byed pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa skra grol ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga dang*/ dar gyi cod pan can mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ dri dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ sku la 'od zer 'phro ba'o// sngar bzhin du rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang bsgom par bya'o// 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi bdag nyid de thams cad rang bzhin gyis rdzogs pa nyid do// sgor g.yon bskor du khwa dang 'ug pa dang*/ khyi dang phag pa'i gdong pa can bzhi dang*/ mtshams su g.yas bskor du gshin rje sreg ma dang*/ pho nya mo dang mche ba can dang 'joms ma rnams mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhin du mos pa bya'o// phyi rol gyi dur khrod ni shar nas g.yon bskor du gtum drag tshang tshing 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i keng rus can 'jigs sde/

dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor du ha ha rgod/ dpal gyi nags/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki la dang brgyad re/ phyogs skyong brgyad dang*/ klu dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ sprin dang*/ grub pa dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ ro langs dang*/ lce spyang gi tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o// 'dir yang dur khrod sum cu so gnyis kyi bdag nyid rdzogs so/ 'di dag kyang khams gsum pa'i brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad rnam par dag pa phyi dang nang dang gzhan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun dang lam dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid yin no// de nas spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad ma la ā dmar po/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ de nas go cha spro bar bya ste/ snying khar nyi ma la oṃ ha bam̐ hi bām̐ hi bī hu bū hu bū he bā+e hā+e be hā+ai bā+ai hā+au bā+au haṃ baṃ haḥb hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā zhes bya ba kha dog dkar dmar g.yon bskor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i ngo bo'o// mgo bor nyi ma la oṃ na hām̐ na hāṃ ni hī ni hī nu hūm̐ nau hūm̐ nā+e heṃ nā+ai hā+ai no hām̐ nā+au hā+au nā+au hā+au ni ham̐ naḥhaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā ser zhing sngo ba rnam par snang mdzad dang gshin rje ma'i rang bzhin no// spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la oṃ swa hī swa hī sri hrī sri hri sū hūm̐ sū hūm̐ swe hweṃ swai hrai so hrī swau hrau swau hraṃ swaḥhra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā zhes bya ba dmar zhing dkar ba pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo'o// dpung pa gnyis kyi nang du nyi ma la oṃ bau hrāṃ ba hraṃ bī hrīṃ bi hriṃ bu hrā+aiṃ bu hrā+au ba hrum̐ bā+ai hrai bā+e hrau baṃ hraṃ ba hra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā zhes bya ba nag cing ser ba he ru ka dang bkrod byed ma'o// spyan gnyis la nyi ma'i steng du oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ham̐ ham̐ hām̐ hām̐ hi hi hī hī hūm̐ hūm̐ heṃ heṃ haiṃ haiṃ/

hoṃ hoṃ hā+auṃ hā+auṃ haṃ hāṃḥhaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā zhes bya ba dmar zhing ljang ba rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'o// mdzod spu'i thad ka'i nang du nyi ma la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phā phā phi phi phu phu phū phū phe phe phā+ai phā+ai pho pho phā+au phā+au pham̐ pham̐ phaḥphaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā zhes bya ba ljang zhing dud kha rta mchog dang gtum mo ste 'di las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros pas rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar du de'i rdul phra rab pa'o// rdo rje phag mo'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar po dang*/ ham̐ yoṃ sngon po snying khar ro// hriṃ mam̐ dkar mo kha la'o// hriṃ hriṃ ser mo mgo bo la'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu spyi gtsug tu'o// phaṭa phaṭa dud kha smin mtshams su bkod de/ de las 'phros pa'i yi ges lus thams cad dgang ba'o// de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bya ste/ de yang 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor ba dang*/ rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan pa dang*/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mdun du spyan drangs te/ sa bon las spros pa'i pi wang ma la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ dzaḥzhes pas rang rang gi steng du dgug pa dang*/ hūm̐ gis chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du gzhug pa dang*/ baṃ gyis bcing ba dang*/ hoḥyis dgyes par bya'o// de nas yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nas 'byung ba'i cha lugs can gyis rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa rnams la yang pi wang ma la sogs pa yis mchod de/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol gyur// de dag la'ang khrus byed 'gyur// lha yi chu yis dag par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du bcug ste zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba lha mo'i pad ma dang gnyis kyi bar nas byung ba'i rang byung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thams cad la blugs par bya'o// de nas lha rnams kyi spyi bo'i chu'i thigs pa rnams las bdag po bsam pa ni/

gtso bo la mi bskyod pa'o// phag mo la 'od dpag med do// pad ma'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan sgo mtshams ma thams cad la don yod grub pas so// de nas oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ ces brjod nas bdag po rnams la thim par gyur to// de nas rang gi sa bon las spros pa'i pi wang ma la sogs pa dang go'u ri la sogs pa lha mo grangs med pa spros pa bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la mchod par bya'o// de yang*/ go'u ri ri dwags sbyar gcan 'dzin// gtso ri ma ni nyi ma'i snod// be ta li ni chu lag ma// sman 'dzin ma ni ghas sma ri// pu ka si ni stobs lag can// sha ri ro 'dzin de bzhin du// tsin dha li ma ḍam ru sgrogs// mgrin pa las mkhyud ḍoṃ bi ni// zhes so// gzhan yang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod nas/ rkang pa brgyad pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bstod de/ bdud rtsi myang ba yang byas la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sku yun ring du gsal bar byas la/ bsgom pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to// de nas bdag po dang longs spyod pa dang thim pa'i rim pas rnal 'byor ma lnga dang*/ kun tu spyod pa dang he ru ka bcu gnyis kyi gzugs yongs su brje ba ni las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o// de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa 'i hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'o// de nas yang hūm̐ las 'od zer thogs pa med pa sems can thams cad mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor byas pa khyer nas 'ongs tshur 'dus te hūm̐ la zhugs pas hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las thig ler gyur te de'i nang du skad cig 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bsgoms te de'i gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom zhing dmigs pa 'di ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas yang thig le'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sa bon las 'od byung ste/

'thon pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg ste zhal gyi sgo nas zhugs te zhu ba rdo rje'i bum par lhung ba las rdo rje nas kyi 'bru tsam gyis lte bar dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang du lhag par mos pa byas te sems brtan par ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya'o// de nas snying kha'i rdo rje drangs te de la bstims nas bzhag go /de dag gis sems rims kyis brtan pa'i rtags/ du ba la sogs pa mthong bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ shri badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ki li dza la sham̐ bha ra swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ sarba bhud dha ḍa ki ni ye badz+ra war ṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ phag mo'i snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra bā+ai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// gzhan yang rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags gtso bo'i hūm̐ yig las byung ste rang gi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam gyis yum gyi pad ma nas 'khor ba'i rim pas bzlas pa'i skyon rnams dang bral bas dung chen gyi phreng ba bzung ste skabs yod na lha ma lus pa'i sngags kyang bzlas par bya'o// de nas lha thams cad bsdus te rang nyid mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis gnas nas gtor ma btang bar bya'o// thun bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ ye shes dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// phag mo dang ni bsres pas ni// bsdus ba pha rol phyin pa ste// 'jig rten khams kyi rnam dag pa'o// srid dang mya ngan 'das gzugs bdag /sgyu ma snying rjes las byung ba'o// thams cad bden min brdzun pa min// skye min mi skye min spangs pa'o// zhes bya ba'i don dran par bya zhing gnas par bya'o// zas kyi dus ni gtor ma sbyang ba'i rim pas dag par bya ste/

snying khar skad cig gis me'i dbus su dkyil 'khor bsams la sbyin bsreg tu bya'o// phyi rol gyi rig ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su ni dga' ba rtsom pa'i rim pas so// khrus kyi dus su dbang bskur ba'i rim pas so// gnyid kyi dus su ni gong bur bsdu ba'i rim pas snying khar thim par bya zhing 'od gsal du 'jug par bya'o// dpal mkha' 'gro mtsho'i snying po'i mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs so// rdo rje 'chang chen gsang ba'i bdag po dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang pad ma badz+ra yi// gsung zer pad ma'i myu gus 'grel mdzad de// sha ba ri dang a ba du ti pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ka ma la badz+ra// mkhas mchog rgyal ba'i sde yis rin chen bdun// spros mdzad rgyud 'grel gdams par bcas pa rnams// sgra bsgyur dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje dang*// dar ma yon tan gnyis kyis legs par bsgyur// bla ma rgya dang seng gha la k+ṣa la// bsgrub thabs yan lag bcas pa kho bos thos// rgya'i slob ma tshul khrims rin chen las/ 'grel pa bshad par bcas pa brgyud pa yin// gzhan yang dar ma yon tan paṇ+ḍi ta// skyob pa dpal dang mnga' ris rin g.yung las// rgyud rkyang bshad pa legs par thos pa yin// spros nyung kun tu 'gro ba'i mngon rtogs 'di// gzhan la phan phyir rang byung rdo rjes sdebs// dge bas 'gro kun bde ba che thob cing*// tshe gcig dpal ldan he ru kar gyur cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
